note: BLM campground and boat ramp on the Eagle River just east of Red Canyon, off I-70 Exit 157 at Wolcott: north from the exit, left on the frontage road (Old Highway 6) at the stop sign, 2 miles past the bridge and the Wolcott Yacht Club, then right at Wolcott Recreation Area and downhill to the campground. A handful of sites on a gravel loop between the frontage road and the river; I-70 runs about 70 m south, just past the frontage road (NAIP). Popular with rafters. A 2022 reviewer on The Dyrt saw sites for 'tents up to a big 5th wheel'. --Claude
summary: BLM page: confirmed $20 (day use $5), season May 15 - Nov 15 (now sourced, was derived from note), FCFS with no reservations, phone (970) 876-9000; added stay limit (7 days May-Aug, 14 Sept-Nov) and platform none. Note cleaned: dropped fee/season/FCFS text the fields carry; reviewer line kept with attribution; 'Highway noise' replaced by the measured I-70 distance.
